Class SolverMultiClosedMonteCarloLogistic

java.lang.Object
solvers.SolverMulti
solvers.multiSolverAlgorithms.SolverMultiClosedMonteCarloLogistic
public class SolverMultiClosedMonteCarloLogistic extends SolverMulti
Solves a multiclass closed model, using Monte Carlo Logistic algorithm.

Ong Wai Hong
